name: Actor
summary: Excel at impersonation and performance; gain advantage when pretending to be someone else and mimic voices or sounds you have studied.

name: Alert
summary: +5 initiative; you cannot be surprised while conscious; hidden attackers do not gain advantage just for being unseen.

name: Athlete
summary: Improve physical mobility: standing from prone is cheaper, climbing is easier, and running jumps need less run-up.

name: Charger
summary: After using Dash, use a bonus action to make a melee attack or shove, with an extra benefit after a straight-line charge.

name: Crossbow Expert
summary: Ignore crossbow loading, make ranged attacks normally in melee, and gain a hand-crossbow bonus-action attack after attacking one-handed.

name: Defensive Duelist
summary: When wielding a finesse weapon, use your reaction to add proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack that hits you.

name: Dual Wielder
summary: Better two-weapon fighting: +1 AC while dual-wielding, use non-light one-handed weapons, and draw or stow two weapons together.

name: Dungeon Delver
summary: Better at finding and surviving traps and secret doors; resist trap damage and search while travelling at normal pace.

name: Durable
summary: Become tougher and get a better minimum result when spending Hit Dice to regain hit points.

name: Elemental Adept
summary: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to that type and treat damage-die rolls of 1 as 2.

name: Grappler
summary: Gain advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and gain an option to restrain both yourself and the grappled creature.

name: Great Weapon Master
summary: Heavy-weapon specialist: gain a bonus attack after a critical hit or dropping a creature, and trade accuracy for major damage.

name: Healer
summary: Use a healer's kit much more effectively, including restoring hit points instead of merely stabilising a dying creature.

name: Heavily Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with heavy armour.

name: Heavy Armor Master
summary: While wearing heavy armour, reduce incoming nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Inspiring Leader
summary: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to six allies so they gain temporary hit points based on your level and Charisma modifier.

name: Keen Mind
summary: Perfectly track direction and time, and accurately recall what you have seen or heard during the past month.

name: Lightly Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with light armour.

name: Linguist
summary: Learn three languages and become skilled at creating written ciphers that others struggle to decipher.

name: Lucky
summary: Gain three luck points per long rest to influence your own attacks, checks, saves, or attacks made against you.

name: Mage Slayer
summary: Fight spellcasters at close range: punish nearby casting, disrupt concentration more effectively, and resist nearby spells better.

name: Magic Initiate
summary: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from another spellcasting class; cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest.

name: Martial Adept
summary: Learn two Battle Master manoeuvres and gain one superiority die to fuel them, refreshed on a short or long rest.

name: Medium Armor Master
summary: Use medium armour more efficiently: remove its Stealth penalty and allow up to +3 Dexterity to AC.

name: Mobile
summary: Increase speed, Dash through difficult terrain more easily, and avoid opportunity attacks from creatures you attack in melee.

name: Moderately Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with medium armour and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
summary: Become more dangerous and protective while mounted, including advantage against smaller unmounted foes and ways to protect your mount.

name: Observant
summary: Read lips when you can see a speaker and gain +5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation.

name: Polearm Master
summary: Gain a bonus-action butt-end attack with certain polearms and trigger opportunity attacks when enemies enter your reach.

name: Resilient
summary: Increase one ability score by 1 and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

name: Ritual Caster
summary: Gain a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from a chosen class and copy more qualifying rituals into it later.

name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn when rolling melee-weapon damage, reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either result.

name: Sentinel
summary: Lock enemies down with opportunity attacks and punish foes who attack nearby allies instead of you.

name: Sharpshooter
summary: Ignore long-range disadvantage and most cover with ranged weapons, and trade accuracy for a large damage bonus.

name: Shield Master
summary: Turn a shield into an active combat tool: shove after attacking, improve some Dexterity saves, and potentially negate certain area damage.

name: Skilled
summary: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Skulker
summary: Hide more effectively in dim conditions, missing with a ranged attack does not automatically reveal you, and dim light does not hinder Perception as much.

name: Spell Sniper
summary: Double the range of attack-roll spells, ignore half and three-quarters cover with them, and learn one attack cantrip from a spellcasting class.

name: Tavern Brawler
summary: Become proficient with improvised weapons, improve unarmed damage, and grapple as a bonus action after hitting with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon.

name: Tough
summary: Your hit-point maximum increases by 2 per character level, including retroactively for levels you already have.

name: War Caster
summary: Gain advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration, cast with occupied hands, and use certain spells for opportunity attacks.

name: Weapon Master
summary: Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

name: Adaptive Colouration
summary: Gain advantage on Stealth checks made to avoid being seen and broaden which koi-dragon colour can empower your Tatsumi racial abilities.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of Ashura
summary: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1. You can occasionally take an additional reaction in a round, while still being limited to one reaction on any single turn. Uses refresh on a long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of the Jorōgumo
summary: Gain proficiency in Deception or Persuasion, cast disguise self several times per long rest, climb at your walking speed including walls and ceilings with your hands free, and ignore difficult terrain caused by webbing.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of the Komainu
summary: Manifest a radiant mane that harms creatures you grapple, and temporarily harden your body to gain AC and stronger Constitution saves at the cost of weaker Dexterity saves. The stone defence has proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of the Nue
summary: Gamble on chaotic power for a temporary bonus or a small amount of unavoidable poison damage, and briefly gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Both benefits have proficiency-bonus uses and refresh on a short or long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of the Wanyūdō
summary: Increase your speed by 10 feet, stand from prone for only 5 feet of movement, and perform a charging slam that can knock either you or the target prone. The slam refreshes on a short or long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Boon of the Ōmukade
summary: Increase Constitution by 1 and choose an elemental damage type. You gain resistance to that type and can react to taking it to empower your next damage roll, with proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Cantrip Combatant
summary: Increase any ability by 1. After casting a cantrip that includes an unarmed strike or melee weapon attack, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
prerequisiteText: Requires Extra Attack and the ability to cast at least one cantrip.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Combo Striker
summary: Increase any ability by 1 and gain extra flexibility with Ryoko’s combo-attack system, letting you collaborate in or initiate an additional combo between long rests.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Dedicated Combatant
summary: Your advanced-weapon-mastery martial level treats half-martial class levels as full levels and non-martial class levels as half levels.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Double Throw
summary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. Once per turn, a Light and Thrown weapon attack can become two separate throws made at disadvantage, with advantage cancelling that penalty.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Draconic Fury
summary: Increase Constitution by 1 and turn Heartening Breath into an optional damaging cone whose elemental damage scales with level.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Elemental Fighting
summary: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your unarmed strikes can deal 1d8 + Strength modifier damage of that type and ignore resistance to that damage.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Elemental Initiate
summary: Choose air, earth, fire, or water. Learn one cantrip and one 1st-level spell from that element, gain one free casting of the 1st-level spell per long rest, and gain a reactive resistance tied to the chosen element. Can be taken more than once.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Enkoh’s Might
summary: Increase Strength by 1 and gain a proficiency-bonus-limited bonus-action shove that can push a creature farther than a normal shove.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Extra Attack Tactician
summary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 and borrow the 7th-level Improved Extra Attack benefit of a chosen martial class for a limited number of uses each long rest.
prerequisiteText: Requires the Improved Extra Attack feature.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Fearsome Flourisher
summary: While fighting with nunchaku, gain a bonus-action follow-up attack and an intimidating flourish that can frighten a nearby creature.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Focused Discipline
summary: Double proficiency for one class-granted skill and treat rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on one class-granted saving throw proficiency.
prerequisiteText: Requires 4th level and a single-class character.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Gift of the Lion Turtle
summary: Increase any ability by 1 and gain slot-free castings of detect thoughts and suggestion once each per long rest, while also allowing them to use your normal spell slots.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Hanamori Physiology
summary: Better resist environmental exhaustion and react to elemental damage to gain resistance to that type through the end of your next turn, with proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Haniwa Soulbinding
summary: Your Clay Companion can use stronger animal forms, with additional forms becoming available from 5th level.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Isetsu Magic
summary: Increase any ability by 1, learn water whip, and gain free daily castings of riptide and water breathing while also being able to cast them with spell slots.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Kaiju Hunter
summary: Mount and brace on enormous creatures using only 5 feet of movement, identify vulnerable areas more reliably, move over giant creatures without their difficult terrain, and counterattack very large foes with your reaction.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Karasu Trickery
summary: Increase Charisma by 1 and occasionally swap your d20 result with another creature when you both make an ability check or saving throw at the same time.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Kitsune’s Blessing
summary: Enhance your fox transformation: cast spells without ordinary material components, gain a damaging bite, Multiattack, and a better transformed AC.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Kusarigama Master
summary: Improve the kusarigama counterweight and trade its damage for disarming, knocking prone, pulling, or grappling a Medium or smaller target.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Magic of the Blade
summary: Increase any ability by 1 and learn two cantrips that include an unarmed strike or melee weapon attack as part of the casting. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as their spellcasting ability.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Martial Initiate
summary: Increase any ability by 1 and learn two tier-1 advanced weapon techniques for which you meet the prerequisites.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Multidisciplinary
summary: Each time you take this feat or gain your first level in a new class, gain either a skill plus artisan-tool proficiency or a saving-throw proficiency offered by the new class.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Oni Regeneration
summary: Increase Constitution by 1 and react to damage by spending Hit Dice to heal yourself, with proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Prosthesis Adept
summary: During a rest, modify a prosthesis with one specialised property such as Blast, Hookshot, Integrated, Launch, Melee, or Mobility; the modification lasts until you reconfigure it.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Prosthesis Fighting
summary: Extend the ranges and reach of prosthesis attacks and deal one extra damage die with their Blast, Launch, or Melee properties.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Prosthesis Master
summary: Become proficient with attacks made using prostheses and attune to one magical prosthesis without using one of your normal attunement slots.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Seasonal Determinism
summary: Choose the season tied to your Fuyōren birth. Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter grants a different +1 ability increase and a matching movement, luck, stealth, or cold-magic benefit.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Shadowmage
summary: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 and learn two druid or sorcerer cantrips that can be cast without components in dim light or darkness.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Spirit Bonded
summary: Learn find familiar and gain one free componentless casting per long rest that allows the familiar to attack. You can also choose one of Ryoko’s special familiar forms, which gains scaling temporary hit points and improvement-tree benefits.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Springtail Agility
summary: Increase Dexterity by 1 and gain a bonus-action leap that costs no movement and avoids opportunity attacks, with proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Tengu Training
summary: Increase Dexterity or Wisdom by 1, gain proficiency with one Finesse weapon, and use a limited reaction to counterattack a creature that misses you with a melee attack while you hold a Finesse weapon.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90

name: Tessen Master
summary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. A tessen gains additional piercing and thrown options for you, and while wielding one you gain a special once-per-round reaction used only to deflect a projectile with its Fan Shield property.
source: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms v0.90
